_comment: This file defines only data constants: Props enum (RED/GREEN/BLUE), PROP_SPEC color ranges, and ROS_PROPS topic mappings. No callable functions, classes, or APIs exist — it is a configuration module with no invokable code.
summarize_Props_enum: summarize the Props enum that defines RED, GREEN, and BLUE blob tracker color properties
review_PROP_SPEC: review the PROP_SPEC dictionary that maps Props to ColorRange lower and upper bounds
review_ROS_PROPS: review the ROS_PROPS dictionary that maps Props to ROS topic paths for blob poses
summarize_blob_tracker_object_defs: summarize the blob tracker object definitions module for color range and ROS topic configuration
review_blob_tracker_object_defs: review the blob tracker object definitions module to understand Props enum and associated color range mappings
